# cCRE enrichment plots

Enrichment results are pre-computed by `run_ccre_enrichment.R`
This Rmd loads the saved RDS files and generates all plots.

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggforce)
mash_folder <- "/project/gilad/geena/publication_clean/results/mash/medianUMI1/"
lfcs <- c(2, 3, 3.5, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10)
```

## 1) Plotting functions
```{r plot_functions}
drop_control <- function(df) filter(df, treatment != "Control")

add_sig_label <- function(df) {
  df %>% mutate(sig_label = case_when(
    p_value < 0.001 ~ "***", p_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
    p_value < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ ""
  ))
}

add_log2_or <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      log2_or      = log2(odds_ratio),
      log2_conf_lo = log2(conf_low),
      log2_conf_hi = log2(conf_high)
    ) %>%
    add_sig_label()
}

######### Response/Nonresponse vs Background plots ########
plot_ccre_condition_paginated <- function(cond_res, lfc, plot_dir,
                                          n_celltypes_per_page = 5,
                                          width = 16, height = 12) {
  df <- cond_res %>%
    filter(treatment != "Control") %>%
    mutate(
      cCRE_class = factor(cCRE_class, levels = c("PLS", "pELS", "dELS")),
      group      = factor(group, levels = c("Response", "Nonresponse"))
    ) %>%
    add_sig_label()

  n_pages <- ceiling(length(unique(df$celltype)) / n_celltypes_per_page)

  pdf(file.path(plot_dir, paste0("ccre_enrich_condition_lfc", lfc, ".pdf")),
      width = width, height = height)

  for (i in seq_len(n_pages)) {
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = cCRE_class, y = odds_ratio, fill = group)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 2, alpha = 0.6) +
      geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.7), width = 0.6) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf_low, ymax = conf_high),
                    position = position_dodge(0.7), width = 0.2) +
      geom_text(aes(label = sig_label, y = conf_high * 1.05),
                position = position_dodge(0.7), vjust = 0, size = 4) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("Response" = "#f53224", "Nonresponse" = "#619CFF")) +
      scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.1))) +
      labs(x = "cCRE class", y = "Odds ratio (vs nonresponse background)",
           title = paste0("Condition-level cCRE enrichment: fold-change ", lfc,
                          " (page ", i, "/", n_pages, ")")) +
      ggforce::facet_grid_paginate(
        celltype ~ treatment, scales = "free_y",
        nrow = n_celltypes_per_page,
        ncol = length(unique(df$treatment)),
        page = i
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1),
            panel.spacing.y = unit(0.4, "lines"),
            panel.clip = "off")
    print(p)
  }
  dev.off()
}

plot_ccre_treatment <- function(df, title_prefix) {
  df <- df %>%
    filter(treatment != "Control") %>%
    mutate(
      cCRE_class = factor(cCRE_class, levels = c("PLS", "pELS", "dELS")),
      group      = factor(group, levels = c("Response", "Nonresponse"))
    ) %>%
    add_sig_label()

  ggplot(df, aes(x = cCRE_class, y = odds_ratio, fill = group)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 2, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.7), width = 0.6) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf_low, ymax = conf_high),
                  position = position_dodge(0.7), width = 0.2) +
    geom_text(aes(label = sig_label, y = conf_high),
              position = position_dodge(0.7), vjust = -0.1, size = 4) +
    facet_wrap(~ treatment, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Response" = "#f53224", "Nonresponse" = "#619CFF")) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.06))) +
    labs(x = "cCRE class", y = "Odds ratio", title = title_prefix, fill = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1))
}

plot_ccre_celltype_paginated <- function(celltype_res, lfc, plot_dir,
                                          n_celltypes_per_page = 3, ncol = 4,
                                          width = 14, height = 10) {
  df <- celltype_res %>%
    mutate(
      cCRE_class = factor(cCRE_class, levels = c("PLS", "pELS", "dELS")),
      group      = factor(group, levels = c("Response", "Nonresponse"))
    ) %>%
    add_sig_label()

  celltypes <- unique(df$celltype)
  panels_per_page <- n_celltypes_per_page * ncol
  n_pages <- ceiling(length(celltypes) / panels_per_page)
  if (n_pages == 0) { message("No celltypes to plot"); return(invisible(NULL)) }

  pdf(file.path(plot_dir, paste0("ccre_enrich_celltype_lfc", lfc, ".pdf")),
      width = width, height = height)

  for (i in seq_len(n_pages)) {
    idx_start <- (i - 1) * panels_per_page + 1
    idx_end   <- min(i * panels_per_page, length(celltypes))
    ct_subset <- celltypes[idx_start:idx_end]
    if (length(ct_subset) == 0) next

    p <- ggplot(df %>% filter(celltype %in% ct_subset),
                aes(x = cCRE_class, y = odds_ratio, fill = group)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 2, alpha = 0.6) +
      geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.7), width = 0.6) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf_low, ymax = conf_high),
                    position = position_dodge(0.7), width = 0.2) +
      geom_text(aes(label = sig_label, y = conf_high * 1.03),
                position = position_dodge(0.7), size = 3.5, vjust = 0) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("Response" = "#f53224", "Nonresponse" = "#619CFF")) +
      facet_wrap(~ celltype, ncol = ncol, scales = "free_y") +
      labs(x = "cCRE class", y = "Odds ratio (vs nonresponse background)",
           title = paste0("Celltype-level cCRE enrichment: fold-change ", lfc,
                          " (page ", i, "/", n_pages, ")")) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
      theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
            axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1),
            panel.spacing = unit(0.6, "lines"))
    print(p)
  }
  dev.off()
}

plot_ccre_global <- function(df, title_prefix) {
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      cCRE_class = factor(cCRE_class, levels = c("PLS", "pELS", "dELS")),
      group      = factor(group, levels = c("Response", "Nonresponse"))
    ) %>%
    add_sig_label()

  ggplot(df, aes(x = cCRE_class, y = odds_ratio, fill = group)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 2, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.7), width = 0.6) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf_low, ymax = conf_high),
                  position = position_dodge(0.7), width = 0.2) +
    geom_text(aes(label = sig_label, y = conf_high),
              position = position_dodge(0.7), vjust = -0.1, size = 5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Response" = "#f53224", "Nonresponse" = "#619CFF")) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.06))) +
    labs(x = "cCRE class", y = "Odds ratio", title = title_prefix, fill = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12)
}

######## Response vs Nonresponse plots #########
plot_resp_vs_nonresp_condition_paginated <- function(df, lfc, plot_dir,
                                                      n_conditions_per_page = 8,
                                                      ncol = 4,
                                                      width = 14, height = 10) {
  df <- add_log2_or(df) %>%
    filter(treatment != "Control") %>%
    mutate(
      cCRE_class = factor(cCRE_class, levels = c("PLS", "pELS", "dELS")),
      condition = paste(celltype, treatment, sep = " | ")
    )

  conditions <- unique(df$condition)
  n_pages <- ceiling(length(conditions) / n_conditions_per_page)

  pdf(file.path(plot_dir, paste0("resp_vs_nonresp_condition_lfc", lfc, ".pdf")),
      width = width, height = height)

  for (i in seq_len(n_pages)) {
    idx <- ((i - 1) * n_conditions_per_page + 1):(i * n_conditions_per_page)
    cond_subset <- conditions[idx]
    cond_subset <- cond_subset[!is.na(cond_subset)]

    p <- ggplot(df %>% filter(condition %in% cond_subset),
                aes(x = cCRE_class, y = log2_or)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
      geom_col(width = 0.6, fill = "#6BAED6") +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = log2_conf_lo, ymax = log2_conf_hi), width = 0.2) +
      geom_text(aes(label = sig_label, y = log2_conf_hi), size = 3.5, vjust = -0.2) +
      facet_wrap(~ condition, ncol = ncol, scales = "free_y") +
      labs(x = "cCRE class", y = "log2 odds ratio (Response vs Nonresponse)",
           title = paste0("Condition-level Response vs Nonresponse cCRE enrichment: fold-change ",
                          lfc, " (page ", i, "/", n_pages, ")")) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
      theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
            axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1),
            panel.spacing = unit(0.6, "lines"))
    print(p)
  }
  dev.off()
}

plot_resp_vs_nonresp_global <- function(df, title) {
  df <- add_log2_or(df) %>%
    mutate(cCRE_class = factor(cCRE_class, levels = c("PLS", "pELS", "dELS")))

  ggplot(df, aes(x = cCRE_class, y = log2_or)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_col(width = 0.6, fill = "#6BAED6") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = log2_conf_lo, ymax = log2_conf_hi), width = 0.2) +
    geom_text(aes(label = sig_label, y = log2_conf_hi), vjust = -0.3, size = 5) +
    labs(x = "cCRE class", y = "log2 odds ratio (Response vs Nonresponse)", title = title) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12)
}

plot_resp_vs_nonresp_treatment <- function(df, title) {
  df <- df %>%
    filter(treatment != "Control") %>%
    add_log2_or() %>%
    mutate(cCRE_class = factor(cCRE_class, levels = c("PLS", "pELS", "dELS")))

  ggplot(df, aes(x = cCRE_class, y = log2_or)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_col(width = 0.6, fill = "#6BAED6") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = log2_conf_lo, ymax = log2_conf_hi), width = 0.2) +
    geom_text(aes(label = sig_label, y = log2_conf_hi), vjust = -0.3, size = 4) +
    facet_wrap(~ treatment, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(x = "cCRE class", y = "log2 odds ratio (Response vs Nonresponse)", title = title) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1))
}

plot_resp_vs_nonresp_celltype_paginated <- function(df, lfc, plot_dir,
                                                     n_celltypes_per_page = 3,
                                                     ncol = 4,

  df <- add_log2_or(df) %>%
    mutate(cCRE_class = factor(cCRE_class, levels = c("PLS", "pELS", "dELS")))

  celltypes <- unique(df$celltype)
  panels_per_page <- n_celltypes_per_page * ncol
  n_pages <- ceiling(length(celltypes) / panels_per_page)

  pdf(file.path(plot_dir, paste0("resp_vs_nonresp_celltype_lfc", lfc, ".pdf")),
      width = width, height = height)

  for (i in seq_len(n_pages)) {
    idx <- ((i - 1) * panels_per_page + 1):(i * panels_per_page)
    ct_subset <- celltypes[idx]
    ct_subset <- ct_subset[!is.na(ct_subset)]

    p <- ggplot(df %>% filter(celltype %in% ct_subset),
                aes(x = cCRE_class, y = log2_or)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
      geom_col(width = 0.6, fill = "#6BAED6") +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = log2_conf_lo, ymax = log2_conf_hi), width = 0.2) +
      geom_text(aes(label = sig_label, y = log2_conf_hi), size = 3.5, vjust = -0.2) +
      facet_wrap(~ celltype, ncol = ncol, scales = "free_y") +
      labs(x = "cCRE class", y = "log2 odds ratio (Response vs Nonresponse)",
           title = paste0("Response vs Nonresponse cCRE enrichment: fold-change ",
                          lfc, " (page ", i, "/", n_pages, ")")) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
      theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
            axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1),
            panel.spacing = unit(0.6, "lines"))
    print(p)
  }
  dev.off()
}
```

## 2) Response/Nonresponse vs Background enrichment
```{r run_vs_background}
results_all <- readRDS(file.path(mash_folder, "ccre_enrichment_vs_background.rds"))

for (lfc in lfcs) {
  plot_dir_lfc <- file.path(mash_folder, paste0("lfc", lfc), "plots")
  dir.create(plot_dir_lfc, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  res <- results_all[[paste0("lfc", lfc)]]

  plot_ccre_condition_paginated(res$condition, lfc, plot_dir_lfc, n_celltypes_per_page = 5)

  p_tx <- plot_ccre_treatment(res$treatment,
                              paste0("Treatment-level cCRE enrichment: fold-change ", lfc))
  ggsave(file.path(plot_dir_lfc, paste0("ccre_enrich_treatment_lfc", lfc, ".pdf")),
         p_tx, width = 15, height = 7)

  plot_ccre_celltype_paginated(res$celltype, lfc, plot_dir_lfc,
                                n_celltypes_per_page = 3, ncol = 4)

  p_gl <- plot_ccre_global(res$global,
                           paste0("Global cCRE enrichment: fold-change ", lfc))
  ggsave(file.path(plot_dir_lfc, paste0("ccre_enrich_global_lfc", lfc, ".pdf")),
         p_gl, width = 6, height = 5)
}
```

## 3) Tables: Response/Nonresponse vs Background
```{r table_vs_background}
table_dir <- file.path(mash_folder, "tables")
dir.create(table_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Global table
global_bg_tbl <- map_dfr(lfcs, function(lfc) {
  results_all[[paste0("lfc", lfc)]]$global %>% mutate(lfc = lfc)
}) %>%
  select(lfc, cCRE_class, group, odds_ratio, conf_low, conf_high, p_value) %>%
  arrange(lfc, factor(cCRE_class, levels = c("PLS", "pELS", "dELS")), group)

write_tsv(global_bg_tbl, file.path(table_dir, "ccre_enrichment_global_vs_background.tsv"))

# Treatment-level table
tx_bg_tbl <- map_dfr(lfcs, function(lfc) {
  results_all[[paste0("lfc", lfc)]]$treatment %>% mutate(lfc = lfc)
}) %>%
  filter(treatment != "Control") %>%
  select(lfc, treatment, cCRE_class, group, odds_ratio, conf_low, conf_high, p_value) %>%
  arrange(lfc, treatment, factor(cCRE_class, levels = c("PLS", "pELS", "dELS")), group)

write_tsv(tx_bg_tbl, file.path(table_dir, "ccre_enrichment_treatment_vs_background.tsv"))

# Celltype-level table
ct_bg_tbl <- map_dfr(lfcs, function(lfc) {
  results_all[[paste0("lfc", lfc)]]$celltype %>% mutate(lfc = lfc)
}) %>%
  select(lfc, celltype, cCRE_class, group, odds_ratio, conf_low, conf_high, p_value) %>%
  arrange(lfc, celltype, factor(cCRE_class, levels = c("PLS", "pELS", "dELS")), group)

write_tsv(ct_bg_tbl, file.path(table_dir, "ccre_enrichment_celltype_vs_background.tsv"))

message("Saved vs-background tables to: ", table_dir)
```

## 4) Response vs Nonresponse enrichment
```{r run_resp_vs_nonresp}
results_all_r_nr <- readRDS(file.path(mash_folder, "ccre_enrichment_resp_vs_nonresp.rds"))

for (lfc in lfcs) {
  plot_dir_lfc <- file.path(mash_folder, paste0("lfc", lfc), "plots")
  dir.create(plot_dir_lfc, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  res <- results_all_r_nr[[paste0("lfc", lfc)]]

  plot_resp_vs_nonresp_condition_paginated(res$condition, lfc, plot_dir_lfc,
                                            n_conditions_per_page = 12, ncol = 4)

  p_gl_rnr <- plot_resp_vs_nonresp_global(
    res$global, paste0("Global Response vs Nonresponse cCRE enrichment: fold-change ", lfc))
  ggsave(file.path(plot_dir_lfc, paste0("resp_vs_nonresp_global_lfc", lfc, ".pdf")),
         p_gl_rnr, width = 6, height = 5)

  p_tx_rnr <- plot_resp_vs_nonresp_treatment(
    res$treatment, paste0("Treatment-level Response vs Nonresponse cCRE enrichment: fold-change ", lfc))
  ggsave(file.path(plot_dir_lfc, paste0("resp_vs_nonresp_treatment_lfc", lfc, ".pdf")),
         p_tx_rnr, width = 15, height = 7)

  plot_resp_vs_nonresp_celltype_paginated(res$celltype, lfc, plot_dir_lfc,
                                           n_celltypes_per_page = 3, ncol = 4)
}
```
